claim_ceiling: No physical product, comfort benefit, cost reduction, safety, service life, or environmental superiority has been established by this fixture.

scope.initial_product: replaceable mattress topper or comfort-layer assembly

existing_owners.responsibility: textile, cover, sewing, washing and textile-product function

design_candidates.description: Named commercially available comparator with documented model, size, bill of materials where obtainable, delivered price, date, and source.
Passive replaceable comfort-layer and cover construction. Exact materials and dimensions are not yet selected.
required_records: bill of materials and source provenance

design_candidates.description: A variant that changes one declared construction variable against MODULAR-TOPPER-V0; the variable must be frozen before evaluating results.
A proposed cover/color/texture variant. Any change to material grade, seams, fit, layer sequence, or function-bearing construction creates a new candidate requiring affected requalification.

proposed_targets.fail_closed_rule: If the comparator, cost date/currency, or a material cost component is missing, outcome is not_evaluable.

proposed_targets.protocol: Use published instructions and common tools; record operator experience, tools, start/end conditions, failed attempts, and replacement-part availability.
Select reference, scale, clinically-neutral wording, randomization/crossover order, sample plan, exclusion rules, uncertainty method and subgroup checks before collecting human data.
Freeze applicable methods, apparatus, specimen conditioning, calibration, uncertainty, repetitions, deviations and acceptance limits before evaluating candidates.
Name a geographically plausible route that accepts the actual identified grade and contamination state. Theoretical recyclability alone does not pass.

negative_controls.scenario: The model predicts good support but no valid physical-test result exists.
negative_controls.invariant: Simulation evidence must not be promoted to physical-test evidence.

negative_controls.scenario: Aggregate comfort improves while a preregistered posture/body subgroup materially worsens.
negative_controls.invariant: An aggregate mean must not hide a declared adverse subgroup result.

negative_controls.scenario: A candidate looks 25 percent cheaper ex-factory, but freight, packaging, labor, or replacements are missing.
negative_controls.invariant: Incomplete cost accounting cannot pass the cost target.

negative_controls.scenario: A source says only 'recycled foam' with no exact grade, provenance, or dated specification.
negative_controls.invariant: Generic category labels do not establish composition or performance.

negative_controls.scenario: Layers use nominally recyclable materials but no identified recovery route accepts the actual joined/contaminated assembly.
negative_controls.invariant: Theoretical recyclability is not demonstrated recovery.

negative_controls.scenario: A cover variant changes a seam, material grade, layer orientation, or fit-bearing dimension without a new revision.
negative_controls.invariant: Style changes cannot silently inherit evidence from a materially different construction.

negative_controls.scenario: A reported result lacks specimen identity, calibration, uncertainty, or test deviations.
negative_controls.invariant: Missing required metrology metadata blocks verification.

negative_controls.scenario: Synthetic protocol data is labelled as a physical measurement.
negative_controls.invariant: Synthetic and measured evidence must remain distinct.

negative_controls.scenario: A firmness rating is presented as proof of greater subjective comfort.
negative_controls.invariant: Firmness is not a substitute for comfort evaluation.

negative_controls.scenario: A rendering is presented as proof of structural stability or manufacturability.
negative_controls.invariant: Visual plausibility does not establish physical or manufacturing performance.

standards_reference_candidates.use: Potential comparative mattress methods; confirm applicability to exact topper assembly and record deviations.
Bed/mattress durability and hardness methods. Firmness rating is not proof of comfort or quality; confirm scope for topper.
Thermal and water-vapour resistance under steady-state test conditions, not complete in-use comfort.
Woven-fabric tensile force and elongation method.
Design-for-disassembly/adaptability principles for construction; inspiration only, not a mattress conformity claim.
